releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.20 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Fixed 4-5h multi-hour freeze bug with supervisor coroutine loops & self-healing auto-restart
* Eliminated GraphicBuffer hardware bitmap leak and added 2.5s screenshot timeout
* Zero-allocation direct pixel sampling in VisualPatternCache with 150-entry LRU cap
* Cleaned up 38 legacy files (removed VisualAdDetector and all obsolete spatial analyzers)
* Enabled UNLIMITED mode and auto-start on Pocket FM by default
